caption: Each round holds one fold out for scoring, shown shaded, and fits on the other four; after five rounds every fold has been tested exactly once. The bottom row is each fold's accuracy, and their mean is 0.81.

spec.title: 5 folds of 200 cases
spec.aria: Five cross-validation rounds across five folds: in each round one fold is held out for testing and four are used for fitting, and the last row lists the five fold accuracies 0.80, 0.82, 0.78, 0.84 and 0.81, whose mean is 0.81.
